question: A 57-year-old man has worsening suprapubic discomfort 36 hours after undergoing a hemorrhoidectomy under spinal anesthesia. He reports that he has not urinated since the procedure. Examination shows a palpable bladder 4 cm above the symphysis pubis. He is treated with a drug that directly increases detrusor muscle tone. This patient is at increased risk for which of the following adverse effects of his treatment?
